findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Every spice, resolved to the particle." → 3 lines (6 words, 74.9px); "One new single-origin lot. Every month. Gone whe" → 4 lines (10 words, 72px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 17 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "01 / Bestsellers" above "Four compounds. Forty thousand repeat or"; "04 / Shop · product index" above "All 28 specimens. Sort them. Fight them."; "Specimen jar / live dye field" above "Stir the pigment."; "02 / Compound sheet" above "The numbers are on the pouch."; "Parameter" above "2,000"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: JetBrains Mono — e.g. "0000:0000", "FREE SHIPPING ABOVE ₹499", "■", "COD AVAILABLE"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "[00]", "/ 04", "01", "02", "03", "04"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 46 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "ASSAYING PARTICLES", "/ 04", "SPECIMEN 01", "34.08°N 74.79°E").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ★ ✓ ☆
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 1 gradient fill(s): div.hero-stick → radial-gradient(120% 90% at 70% 40%, rgb(26, 29, 32) 0%, rgb(15, 17, 19) 62%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 56 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): header.nav.mono 1440px | div.spec-head 302px | div 302px | div 302px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 16 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 17 dashed/dotted border(s).
findings.fix: Remove unless it is a real drop zone.

findings.message: 2 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (4, 12 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 155 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The title is not readable 1.2s after the page loaded (something lies over it).
findings.fix: Put the headline in the HTML, painted on the first frame; the load sequence only adds arrival and is settled by 1.2s (references/motion.md, "Load sequence in 1.2 seconds"). No preloader, no gate, no waiting for the load event.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit within 16px of the screen edge: "NO FILLERS / PRESERVATIVES" (5px from the left)
findings.fix: Keep text inside the page margin (16–32px or more). Only display type deliberately bled past the edge may touch it.

findings.message: Left-aligned text starts at 11 different lines (88px, 103px, 48px, 419px, 735px, 1050px, 262px); the three most used hold only 58% of it.
findings.fix: Pick two or three anchor lines from the grid and start every heading and paragraph on one of them.

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Every spice, resolved to the particle." (screen 3, 100% hidden); "Four compounds." (screen 4, 100% hidden); "All 28 specimens." (screen 5, 100% hidden); "Stir the" (screen 8, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Every spice, resolved to the particle." (screen 3, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "Every spice, resolved to the particle."
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: Little motion: 10 element(s) moved while the page loaded and scrolled.
findings.fix: Give every section an entrance for its parts (not one fade of the whole block) and add one moving picture: a looping clip or a slow move on a photograph.

findings.message: 3 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "Every spice, resolved to the particle." → 3 lines (6 words, 41px); "Four compounds. Forty thousand repeat orders." → 3 lines (6 words, 34px); "One new single-origin lot. Every month. Gone whe" → 4 lines (10 words, 34px)

findings.message: 2 rows of identical boxed cards.
findings.fix: Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.
